definitions.explanation: The act of creating a three-dimensional form or shape, whether by sculpting, molding, or other methods. Also refers to the resulting form or design.
The visual and spatial arts that involve creating physical forms, including sculpture, architecture, and design. Used as a broad category in art and education.
